metadata.purpose: internal educational FaceNet input preparation, not MTCNN
metadata.output_contract: RGB uint8 (160,160,3) after reading PNG as BGR then cvtColor

metadata.terms: Education/research with citation; local project use; no public dataset upload.
metadata.citation: Nordstrom et al. The IMM Face Database - An Annotated Dataset of 240 Face Images. DTU, 2004.
metadata.transport: HTTP explicitly approved by user; HTTPS hostname mismatch; TLS verification was not disabled.
metadata.integrity_note: Pinned self-computed hash from prior download, not a DTU-published checksum; does not authenticate original publisher bytes.

calibration_protocol.choose: lowest threshold with calibration FAR <= target

metadata.output_contract: RGB uint8 (160,160,3) after BGR-to-RGB read conversion

calibration_protocol.choose: lowest threshold with calibration FAR <= target

limitations: Identity labels are dataset-provided, not independently verified from face content.
MTCNN demo/group/crop identities are unknown; excluded pending manual provenance review.
decoded pixel hash does not prove absence of visual near-duplicates.
Original archive hash is self-computed; no DTU publisher checksum available.
pixel_hash_definition: SHA256(canonical JSON shape/dtype/channel order + NUL + decoded RGB/RGBA/GRAY C-order bytes); no resize/alignment/EXIF transpose
